title: Google Maps Now Plans Your Whole Trip 🗺️
description:
Google Maps can now plan your whole trip: Ask Maps builds a day-by-day itinerary with a numbered pin for every stop, live traffic, opening hours and new stops on request. In the U.S. it can even call local businesses like salons, pet groomers and garages to find you an appointment, and Ask Maps is now in more than 200 countries and territories on Android and iOS.

Would you let AI plan your next trip? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for the newest AI tools and tech news every day.

Source: Google, "New Ask Maps features for the holidays" (November 16, 2026); TechCrunch (November 16, 2026)
